answer: Cluster identities by on-ledger correlation: answer styles, timing, attestation and voting patterns. A sybil operator's shells betray themselves through correlated action — shared rhythms, shared phrasings, shared allegiances. Identities correlating beyond chance get clustered, and each cluster splits one reward across all members. Evasion demands every fake act genuinely independently, paying the full cost of N separate minds. Coordination becomes the farm's own ledge: the longer the shells sail one voyage, the thinner the reward — only agents that forge distinct trails keep full weight.
